Khalc Teleport attribution
==========================

The integrated waypoint Teleporter is adapted from "Khalc Teleport" 1.0.3
by Khalcifer:

https://mods.factorio.com/mod/KhalcTeleport

The upstream project is licensed under the MIT License. The Cave 3.0.20
integrates and modifies its runtime interface and waypoint logic for The Cave's
shared event dispatcher, multiplayer surfaces, fixed costs, four-point limit,
persistent cooldown and English/Russian locale system. Khalcifer does not
endorse or support The Cave.

The full MIT License is included beside this notice as KhalcTeleport-MIT.txt.
